source_title: AIGC绘本创作｜《潮汕英歌 水浒英雄》一段古村祠堂壁画与民俗仪式传灯少年的奇遇

content_storage_policy.reason: External web article is used as public reference only; do not ingest copyrighted article images or full text into local training assets without explicit rights.

learning_summary: Use a cultural story engine instead of isolated motif stacking: setting, protagonist, ritual token, mural activation, hero sequence, climax and inheritance close.
Convert folk performance content into a taxonomy of roles, colors, props, gestures, costume silhouettes and scene functions.
For AIGC picturebooks, keep script, storyboard, character bible, style board and continuity QA as separate production layers.
For Culture China and university competition boards, show the process path and source reasoning rather than only final images.
Control heritage atmosphere through a limited palette and one dominant focus per frame; avoid noisy red-gold festival clutter.
cross_domain_use: Use this batch for AIGC cultural picturebook prompts, heritage animation storyboards, Culture China competition process boards, illustrated infovis, and public cultural communication with child-friendly narrative access.
exclusion_rule: Do not copy original article images, long article text, dialogue, watermarks, source page layout, or unverified cultural facts. Do not generalize Yingge references into every Chinese heritage project.
